corrections.reason: The character ቸ in ገዢዎቻቸውንም is clearly printed on the page and required by Amharic plural possessive grammar (translating ወመኳንንቲሆሙ).
Both the printed glyph (ክሙ) and canonical Ge'ez Luke 22:27 ('among you', translated in Col 2 L02 as አገለገልኋችሁ) confirm ማእከሌክሙ rather than ማእከሌሆሙ.
Classical Ge'ez vocative particle ኦ (ኦጴጥሮስ = 'ጴጥሮስ ሆይ' in L23) is printed with the 7th-order loop on the right leg, misread as 1st-order አ.
